messages:
Maya C: Weekly check-in for AcmeTech private/VPC deployment. Need a short region-by-region health snapshot (uptime, connectivity, KMS/HSM issues, spend blips). TL;DR: customer saw auth failures in eu-west-1 and VPN flaps in ap-southeast-1 — can SE/Infra summarize?

Owen R: grabbing metrics now, will paste the quick table I pulled at 09:10 UTC.

Owen R: eu-west-1 — uptime 99.97% (7d window), P50 42ms, P95 180ms, errors +2.4% WoW. Root cause: intermittent KMS AccessDenied events during key unwrap. See sample: `KMS AccessDeniedException keyId=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/xxxx caller=redwood-vpc-proxy`

Owen R: ap-southeast-1 — uptime 99.88% (7d), P50 78ms, P95 310ms, observed 3 minor VPN tunnel flaps (BGP session down ~90s each). NAT gateway error rate spiked during flaps.

Owen R: us-west-2 — uptime 99.99%, no KMS issues, small cache miss increase after deploy on 2026-03-09.

Priya S: For the eu-west-1 KMS failures I correlated with customer's KMS IAM policy change on 2026-03-08. We see failed STS AssumeRole + AccessDenied at the same timestamps. Sample from proxy logs: ```2026-03-09T14:21:03Z ERROR KMS AccessDeniedException key=arn:... user=acmetech-app role=session-123```

Priya S: HSM: we saw two `HSM TIMEOUT` entries tied to key wrapping in ap-southeast-1 during the VPN flaps: ```2026-03-09T03:12:11Z WARN HSM TIMEOUT slot=2 cmd=wrap_key duration=12s``` That caused retries and higher tail latency.

Maya C: Action items so far: 1) SE to confirm IAM policy rollback or add allow for redwood-vpc-proxy principal (Owen). 2) Infra to investigate VPN stability & HSM timeouts (Priya) and share interim mitigations. 3) CS to flag renewal risk if errors persist (Maya).

Owen R: Filed SE ticket SE-7189 with suggested policy snippet and test steps. Quick snippet to validate from customer's side: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --key-id alias/acme-dev --region eu-west-1`. If that returns AccessDenied we have IAM mismatch.

Priya S: Infra ticket INF-2218 opened for VPN flaps — root suspect: provider-side BGP resets during maintenance window. Working with network partner to get commit. Temporary mitigation: routing fallback to dedicated peering path for the affected subnets.

redwood-deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-09T02:58:05Z completed to ap-southeast-1 (canary). No errors in deploy logs.

Liam K (AcmeTech): thanks team — saw the auth failures around 14:20 UTC yesterday, caused a few failed inference requests in our staging. Can you confirm rollback or fix ETA? Also need note for renewal ops.

Maya C: ETA: SE will validate IAM fix by EOD today, Infra aiming to stabilize VPN by tomorrow EOB. I'll schedule a 30m sync with AcmeTech 2026-03-11 15:00 UTC to review. If errors persist we'll escalate to enterprise support and put a retention hold on the renewal timeline.

Owen R: I'll also add a short synthetic to hit KMS unwrap paths every 5m from eu-west-1 to detect regressions.

Priya S: Uploading HSM debug bundle to ticket INF-2218 and linking runbook: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/hsm-vpc-connectivity|HSM-VPC troubleshooting>.

Maya C: Thanks — I'll update the account health deck and renewal tracker after the sync. Closing here unless new blocks. :white_check_mark:
